gaps.sentence: This time yesterday we ___ on the beach.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous for an action in progress at a past moment.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ delivered every morning at eight.
There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: In negative sentences use 'any' with uncountable nouns.

gaps.sentence: He ran so fast that we lost ___ of him.
gaps.explanation: 'lose sight of somebody' = no longer see them.

gaps.sentence: We could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: 'hear + object + -ing' for an action in progress.
